fields.description: Issue includes reporting and commentary on alleged financial shortages revealed by audits in Miami city departments (including the Recreation Director's office and the city garage/warehouse), discussion of investigations and grand jury activity, and criticism of bankruptcy-related rackets. Also features extensive editorial content on bookmaking versus pari-mutuel horse racing interests, a public safety campaign page addressing automobile and bicycle accidents, and coverage of Miami Life's "Most Attractive Working Girl" contest naming Mrs. Lois-Haynes Walta (Southern Bell Telephone Company) as a weekly winner.
